दृप्त mfn. mad, wild, proud, arrogant (-तर, compar.), MBh.; Kāv. &c. (cf. अ॑-द्˚ and अ-दृपित॑).

दृप्यत् mfn. being proud or arrogant, W. (cf. अ॑-द्˚).
दृप्र mfn. strong, Uṇ. ii, 13, Sch. (cf. दूप्र)
